parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the primary cluster.

parameters.name: EnableGlobalDomainName
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create a global domain name.

parameters.name: GDNDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the GDN. The description must meet the following requirements:

*   It cannot start with [http:// or https://.](http://https://。)
*   It must start with a letter.
*   It can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
*   It must be 2 to 126 characters in length.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb create-global-database-network --db-cluster-id pc-bp1q76364ird00000 --gdn-description GDN-fortest --resource-group-id rg-000000000000 --gdn-version 2.0 --enable-global-domain-name false --region cn-hangzhou
